entities.name: The Boreal
entities.description: Permafrost-covered tundra region in the extreme north of Terisiare during the Ice Age, later flooded and lost beneath the Sea of Laments.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Dark tower guarding the Boreal's southern terminus.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: Cult whose unnatural magic altered the Boreal's creatures.

entities.name: Rimewind Keep
entities.description: Home of the Cult of Rimewind.

entities.name: The Thaw
entities.description: Event after which the Boreal was flooded.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: Sea beneath which the Boreal now lies.

events.summary: Cold radiating from Rimewind Keep keeps the Boreal magically frozen through the first part of the Thaw.
events.quote: The Boreal stayed magically frozen even through the first part of the Thaw

events.summary: The Boreal is flooded after the Thaw and is lost beneath the Sea of Laments.
events.quote: The Boreal was flooded after the Thaw and is now lost beneath the Sea of Laments .

relations.quote: The Cult of Rimewind made its home here at Rimewind Keep
